main_text.p: habuit, a quo primum civitas condita est, auctoris nomine vocitata. Ex hoc Irad{a} Gaidad[?] lib. Gre. atque ex eo Maviael nascitur. Hic Mathusalam{b} Mathu-sael[?] Cod. Ebr. filium habuit, ilq; Lamech genuit, a quo {c}juvenis vir juve-nis. quidam occisus traditur, nec tamen nomē refertur occili, quod quidem futuro mysterio fuisse praemissum a prudentibus aestimatur. Igitur Adam post necem filii minoris. Seth filium pro-Gen. 4.creavit, cum jam tricesimum & ducentesi.mum[?] annum aetatis implesset. Vixit autē annos DCCCCXXX. Seth vero Enos, Enos Cainā, Cainan{d} Malaleel[?] Malaleel Iared, Iared Enoch genuit: qui ob{e} Virtutis in qua & pietas. justitia translatus a Deo traditur. Hujus filius Mathusala dictus est, qui Lamech genuit: ex quo Noë Noë. natus, justitia egregius, & praeceteris mortalibus Domino carus acceptusque.

Qua tempestate cum jam humanū genus abundaret, angeli, quibus cælū sedes erat, speciosarū forma virginum capti, illicitas cupiditates appetierunt: ac naturæ suę originisq; degeneres, relictis Superiobus, quorū incolæ erant, matrimoniis se mortalibus miscuerūt. Hi paulatim mores nō-xios conferentes, humana corrupere pro geniem, ex quorū coitu Gigates editi esse

page.notes: The page number, if printed at the top right, is a faint mark I could not read with certainty, so it is left out. "Gaidad" in the first note, the note "Mathu-sael", "Malaleel" in the d-note and the Greek note at "tran." (Lxx) are doubtful and marked [?]. The Greek name in the Lxx note could not be read letter by letter and should be checked against the scan. "ducentesi.mum" has a printed full stop where a hyphen would be expected, copied as printed. "Superiobus" and "humanū" are copied as printed.
